items.source: Note that attribute values are not converted when accessed. For example, it is not possible to call getString(String) if the underlying attribute is an int. The only exception to this rule is Class and Class[] values which may be accessed as String and String[] respectively to prevent potential early class initialization.
items.translation: 请注意，访问属性值时不会进行转换。例如，如果底层属性是`int` 类型，则无法调用getString(String)。此规则的唯一例外是`Class`和`Class[]` 值，它们可以分别作为`String`和`String[]` 访问，以防止潜在的类过早初始化。

items.source: If this merged annotation was created from an AnnotatedElement then this source will be an element of the same type. If the annotation was loaded without using reflection, the source can be of any type, but should have a sensible toString(). Meta-annotations will always return the same source as the root.
items.translation: 如果此合并注解是通过 `from` 方法从 `AnnotatedElement` 创建的，则此源将是相同类型的元素。如果注解未使用反射加载，则源可以是任何类型，但应具有合理的 `toString()`。元注解将始终返回与 `root` 相同的源。

items.source: A directly declared annotation has a distance of 0, a meta-annotation has a distance of 1, a meta-annotation on a meta-annotation has a distance of 2, etc. A missing annotation will always return a distance of -1.
items.translation: 直接声明的注解距离为 `0`，元注解的距离为 `1`，元注解上的元注解距离为 `2`，依此类推。缺失 的注解将始终返回距离 `-1`。

items.source: Attribute values may be accessed using the various get methods. For example, to access an int attribute the getInt(String) method would be used.
items.translation: 属性值可以使用各种 `get` 方法进行访问。例如，要访问一个 `int` 类型的属性，将使用 getInt(String) 方法。

items.source: If necessary, a MergedAnnotation can be synthesized back into an actual Annotation.

items.source: A directly present annotation is one that the user has explicitly declared and not one that is meta-present or @Inherited.
items.translation: 直接存在的注解是指用户显式声明的注解，而非元存在的或带有@Inherited注解的。

items.source: Can be used to reorder a stream of annotations, for example, to give a higher priority to annotations declared on a superclass or interface. A missing annotation will always return an aggregate index of -1.
